pages.quiz:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which letter sounds like "ts" in "Zimmer"? (1 mark)
   A. z
   B. sch
   C. w
   D. ch

2. What does "das Haus" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. house
   B. room
   C. door
   D. clock

3. What does "der Reis" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. apple
   B. cabbage or kale
   C. rice
   D. sugar

4. Which room do you link with "Ich koche"? (1 mark)
   A. das Badezimmer
   B. der Garten
   C. die Küche
   D. das Schlafzimmer

5. What does "Entschuldigung" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. see you tomorrow
   B. good day (daytime greeting)
   C. good night
   D. sorry, excuse me

6. Which day comes right before Mittwoch? (1 mark)
   A. Samstag
   B. Freitag
   C. Montag
   D. Dienstag

7. Which day comes right before Freitag? (1 mark)
   A. Samstag
   B. Donnerstag
   C. Mittwoch
   D. Montag

8. What does "der Samstag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. weekend
   B. Thursday
   C. Saturday
   D. Tuesday

9. Which German word is the number 3? (1 mark)
   A. zwölf
   B. drei
   C. achtzehn
   D. fünf

10. Which German word is the number 10? (1 mark)
   A. zehn
   B. dreizehn
   C. vier
   D. acht

11. Which month is "Dezember"? (1 mark)
   A. September
   B. November
   C. December
   D. October

12. What does "der Mais" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tomato
   B. maize
   C. watermelon
   D. banana

13. What does "das Brot" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. carrot
   B. onion
   C. bread
   D. cheese

14. What does "lecker" mean? (1 mark)
   A. tasty
   B. big
   C. cold
   D. healthy

15. What does "die Schulter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. toe
   B. shoulder
   C. tooth
   D. face

16. What does "das Bein" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. leg
   B. eye
   C. arm
   D. hand

17. What does "helfen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to help
   B. to drink
   C. to learn or study
   D. to sleep

18. Which is the correct way to write "living room"? (1 mark)
   A. das Wohnzimmer
   B. die Wohnzimmer
   C. das Wohnzimer
   D. der Wohnzimmer

19. What do you label on a floor plan? (1 mark)
   A. the meals
   B. the rooms
   C. the days
   D. the weather

20. Which little word goes with the noun "Toilette"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. das
   C. der
   D. den

21. What does "essen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to eat
   B. to smell
   C. to help
   D. to play

22. Which German word or phrase means "Wednesday"? (1 mark)
   A. der Sonntag
   B. der Montag
   C. der Mittwoch
   D. der Dienstag

23. Which little word goes with the noun "Samstag"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. der
   C. den
   D. die

24. Which German word or phrase means "song"? (1 mark)
   A. das Lied
   B. das Geschenk
   C. der Kuchen
   D. die Kerze

25. What does "Oktober" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. December
   B. June
   C. October
   D. July

26. Which German word or phrase means "balloon"? (1 mark)
   A. der Luftballon
   B. die Party
   C. das Geschenk
   D. das Lied

27. Which food group does "die Wassermelone" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Obst
   B. die Getränke
   C. das Fleisch
   D. das Gemüse

28. Which food group does "die Zwiebel" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Fleisch
   B. das Obst
   C. das Gemüse
   D. die Getränke

29. Which little word goes with the noun "Banane"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. das
   C. der
   D. den

30. Which German word or phrase means "rain"? (1 mark)
   A. das Wetter
   B. der Wind
   C. der Regen
   D. der Nebel

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Name two ways to make the kitchen safer at home. (2 marks)

32. Unscramble the letters KLAT and NEGER. (2 marks)

33. Say why all nouns in a German text begin with capital letters and how this helps a reader. (2 marks)

34. Write the German words with der, die or das for: plate, lamp, tomato, knee. (4 marks)

35. Write the German words with der, die or das for: sky, cooker. (2 marks)

36. Explain why a menu uses a colon after the meal name. (2 marks)

37. Write the German words with der, die or das for: room, sun. (2 marks)

38. Write the German words with der, die or das for: present, aunt, mango. (3 marks)

39. Write the German words with der, die or das for: birthday, banana, tummy, apple, cheese. (5 marks)

40. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cloud, cake, toe. (3 marks)

41. Write the German words with der, die or das for: tea, tooth. (2 marks)

42. Write the German names of these months: April, May, June. (3 marks)

43. Write three German sentences describing a member of your family. (3 marks)

44. Read: "Kamau hat Geburtstag. Er ist zehn Jahre alt." Say in English who has a birthday and how old he is. (2 marks)

45. Write the German words with der, die or das for: watermelon, pot. (2 marks)

46. Write the German words with der, die or das for: grandfather, plate. (2 marks)

47. Write these numbers in German: 4, 9, 12. (3 marks)

48. Write these numbers in German: 14, 16, 18. (3 marks)

49. Write the German words with der, die or das for: fish, living room, rain. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #8 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — z
   German z is pronounced ts.

2. A — house
   das Haus means house.

3. C — rice
   der Reis means rice.

4. C — die Küche
   We cook in the kitchen.

5. D — sorry, excuse me
   Entschuldigung means sorry, excuse me.

6. D — Dienstag
   Before Mittwoch comes Dienstag.

7. B — Donnerstag
   Before Freitag comes Donnerstag.

8. C — Saturday
   der Samstag means Saturday.

9. B — drei
   3 in German is drei.

10. A — zehn
   10 in German is zehn.

11. C — December
   Dezember is the last month of the year.

12. B — maize
   der Mais means maize.

13. C — bread
   das Brot means bread.

14. A — tasty
   lecker means tasty.

15. B — shoulder
   die Schulter means shoulder.

16. A — leg
   das Bein means leg.

17. A — to help
   helfen means to help.

18. A — das Wohnzimmer
   Wohnzimmer is a das noun and begins with a capital letter.

19. B — the rooms
   A floor plan is a picture of the rooms seen from above.

20. A — die
   It is die Toilette, so the little word is die.

21. A — to eat
   essen means to eat.

22. C — der Mittwoch
   Wednesday in German is der Mittwoch.

23. B — der
   It is der Samstag, so the little word is der.

24. A — das Lied
   song in German is das Lied.

25. C — October
   Oktober means October.

26. A — der Luftballon
   balloon in German is der Luftballon.

27. A — das Obst
   die Wassermelone belongs to das Obst.

28. C — das Gemüse
   die Zwiebel belongs to das Gemüse.

29. A — die
   It is die Banane, so the little word is die.

30. C — der Regen
   rain in German is der Regen.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: Keep hot pots and matches away from small children; never leave the cooker alone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: kalt and Regen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each; nouns with a capital letter, adjectives with a small letter.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is a spelling rule. Readers can spot the nouns quickly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the rule and 1 mark for the help.

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Teller, die Lampe, die Tomate, das Knie.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Himmel, der Herd.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: The colon announces the list of food that follows.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for announces the list and 1 mark for an example.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Zimmer, die Sonne.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Geschenk, die Tante, die Mango.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

39. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Geburtstag, die Banane, der Bauch, der Apfel, der Käse.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Wolke, der Kuchen, der Zeh.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Tee, der Zahn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: April, Mai, Juni.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Meine Mutter heißt Neema. Sie ist jung. Sie ist lustig.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence with capital letters and full stops.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Kamau has a birthday and he is ten years old.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each fact.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Wassermelone, der Topf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Opa, der Teller.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: vier, neun, zwölf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: vierzehn, sechzehn, achtzehn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Fisch, das Wohnzimmer, der Regen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).
